hardware: NVIDIA RTX 3090 Ti, 24 GiB; one GPU; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=8
implementation: Persistent GPU/FMM+MBJ worker, direct regular VSW E/H, two resident current vectors, bounded angular projection cache, atomic modal-column restart
large_case_scope: Only 4 of 4800 columns computed. No complete large T or large-order Mueller average was computed.
full_case_scope: All 160 columns computed on 12672 unknowns, then analytic uniform SO(3) mean of all 16 Mueller elements at 181 scattering angles.

validation.tests: 8 Python tests passed: 5 T/CG/Mie tests, 2 direct regular-wave tests, 1 GPU partial-build/restart/operator-signature test.
validation.strict_column_acceptance: Independent FP64 residual <= requested tolerance; cached columns revalidated before reuse.
validation.new_direction_checks: Three new incident directions, ten outgoing directions, both polarizations; excluded from spherical projection quadrature.

cost_pilot.qualification: Extrapolation from two low-order modal pairs; later modes, nonlinear scaling, and large-order postprocessing were not timed. Count independent directions after existing alpha/symmetry reuse.

precision_control.scope: Same 66-iteration pair, FP64 near vs FP32 near, both with final strict FP64 verification. This calibrates the new worker to the existing mixed profile, not a claimed new speedup of the repository baseline.

remaining_limits: Automatic analytic Mueller postprocessing remains the small-order reference, L<=8; large-order T building/export is supported.
Full 4800-channel T and its optimized SO(3) postprocessor remain uncomputed/unbenchmarked.
A highly refined low-frequency control (ka=3, m=1.5, 202752 unknowns, MBJ50) stagnated and was stopped; convergence is case dependent.
Projected and algebraic residuals do not establish surface discretization accuracy; independent shape/mesh convergence remains required.
reproduction: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 python3 scripts/build_fmm_tmatrix.py --shape prism --ref 5 --ka 25 --ri 1.3 --order 48 --angular-band 64 --tol 1e-5 --restart 80 --max-iters 100 --columns 0 4 --no-average --out runs/prism_tmatrix
